title: Cancellation-Free Constrained SquareCB for Safe Controller Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.21880v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study constrained contextual bandits, in which a learner chooses one of $K$ actions in each round to minimize loss while keeping the expected cost of its play below a budget. Existing reductions to online regression weight the cost by a Lagrange multiplier learned from past constraint residuals, so slack in some rounds can offset violations in others. We instead run SquareCB proposed in \citep{foster2020beyond} with a rectified weight on the cost: it is zero when the estimated cost is within the budget, and otherwise just large enough to bring it back to the budget. Under realizability and Slater's condition with margin $\delta$, the algorithm attains regret $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)}/\delta)$ and cancellation-free violation $\sum_t(V_c^{p_t}-b)^+=O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)})$, where $\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}$ is the error of the regression oracle. translated_title: 用于安全控制器选择的无抵消约束SquareCB算法
translated_abstract: 我们研究约束上下文老虎机问题，其中学习者在每一轮从 $K$ 个动作中选择一个，以最小化损失，同时使其动作的期望成本保持在预算以下。现有的到在线回归的归约方法使用从过去约束残差中学习到的拉格朗日乘子对成本进行加权，因此某些轮次的松弛量可能会抵消其他轮次的违约。我们转而在成本上施加修正权重来运行 Foster 等人（2020）提出的 SquareCB：当估计成本在预算之内时权重为零，否则权重恰好足够大以将成本拉回预算。在可实现性假设以及具有边际 $\delta$ 的 Slater 条件下，该算法达到遗憾 $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)}/\delta)$ 和无抵消违约 $\sum_t(V_c^{p_t}-b)^+=O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)})$，其中 $\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}$ 是回归预言机的误差。当预算必须在（原文摘要在此处截断，后续内容缺失）……
tldr: 该论文提出一种对成本施加修正权重（预算内权重为零、超预算时恰好拉回预算）的约束SquareCB算法，在可实现性和带边际 δ 的 Slater 条件下实现了 $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)}/\delta)$ 的遗憾和无需轮次间抵消的违约界 $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)})$，适用于安全控制器选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a constrained SquareCB that applies a rectified weight to the cost—zero when the estimated cost is within budget and just large enough to pull it back otherwise—achieving $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)}/\delta)$ regret and cancellation-free violation $O(\sqrt{KT\,\mathrm{Reg}_{\mathsf{Sq}}(T)})$ for safe controller selection.
